result.stdout:
edgehop — code-graph indexer, query CLI, and MCP server.

Usage: edgehop <command> [options]

Indexing:
  index <sln|dir> [--branch b] [--dry-run] [--watch] [--no-worktree]
  prune --branch <b> --yes
  branches
  install-hooks <sln|dir> [--repo p]
  uninstall-hooks [--repo p]

Querying:
  find-symbol <query> [--kind k] [--limit n] [--branch b] [--json]
  get-callers <symbolId> [--depth 1-10] [--branch b] [--json]
  get-relationships <symbolId> [--direction out|in|both] [--edge-type T] [--depth 1-10] [--branch b] [--json]
  get-path <fromId> <toId> [--edge-type T] [--max-length 1-15] [--branch b] [--json]
  stats [--top n] [--branch b] [--json]

MCP server:
  mcp                         run the stdio MCP server (used by Claude Code)

  --version                   print the tool version
